classes.name: Defender
classes.description: +25% max health and takes 20% less damage. Firewall Rule, Access Lockdown and Site Survey hit harder.

classes.name: Analyst
classes.description: Heals 8 health for every correct answer, and weak points take 1.75x damage instead of 1.5x. Patch Deploy, Honeypot Lure and Zero Trust Verify hit harder.

classes.name: Cryptographer
classes.description: +25% damage on every skill, but 15% less max health. Integrity Check hits harder, and future cryptography skills will too.
